## Build Failure Analysis

**Solution:** `BuildDiag.sln` (3 projects: `Core.csproj`, `Services.csproj`, `Api.csproj`)

---

### Root Cause Error (1 of 1)

**Project:** `Services.csproj`  
**Issue:** Missing NuGet package reference to `Newtonsoft.Json`

The file `Services/UserService.cs` uses `Newtonsoft.Json` (`JObject`, etc.) but `Services.csproj` has no `<PackageReference>` for it. The project only references `Core.csproj` — no package dependencies at all.

**Errors:**
| Code | File | Message |
|------|------|---------|
| CS0246 | UserService.cs(2) | Namespace `Newtonsoft` not found |
| CS0246 | UserService.cs(3) | Namespace `Newtonsoft` not found |
| CS0246 | UserService.cs(22) | Type `JObject` not found |

---

### Cascading Failures

**`Api.csproj`** depends on `Services.csproj` via `<ProjectReference>`. While the binlog shows Api didn't emit its own compiler errors (MSBuild stopped it before compilation), the solution-level build failed because Services failed. Api would not build successfully until Services is fixed.

---

### Fix

Add the missing package reference to `Services/Services.csproj`:

```xml
<ItemGroup>
  <PackageReference Include="Newtonsoft.Json" Version="13.0.3" />
</ItemGroup>
```

Alternatively, if the intent is to use `System.Text.Json` (the modern built-in alternative), replace the `Newtonsoft.Json` usings in `UserService.cs` with `System.Text.Json` equivalents — no package needed.
